notes.title: SSS Fight! will soon be available for FREE on Steam!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

In order to celebrate the one year release mark of Supernatural Super Squad Fight! I am making the game available for free which will allow the game to potentially reach a larger audience.  No Ads, no in-app purchases, just plain FREE!

Thanks!

notes.title: Free Demo Available on Windows, Mac, and Linux!
notes.notes: Hey everyone!  Try Supernatural Super Squad Fight! for FREE!  Steam has just approved the release of SSS Fight! Free Demo.

notes.title: Thanks to all that participated in Beta testing!
notes.notes: SSS Fight! has been officially approved for release!  Thanks everyone who helped find issues during the beta testing!

notes.title: Something EPIC is on the way!
Looking for Beta Testers!
notes.notes: Hi, do you enjoy testing games and trying to find issues?  SSSFight!  will be opened up to Beta testers in the next week or two!  Please reply if you are interested.
